gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-runic: Woodgod's lowercase climbs nearly to capital height, giving its vintage letters a commanding stance. Noto Sans Runic has a big x-height, so a modest size already fills the line nicely.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Generously opened bowls and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals give Woodgod a vintage command. Noto Sans Sharada handles the quieter work, its open c forms and bulky lowercase suiting sans-serif text.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac is friendly and modern, with lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs. Woodgod commands attention with its vintage, near-capital lowercase, while the plain sans below offers easy s shapes with generous turns.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-syriac-e: Woodgod pulls its lowercase up almost to capital height, a vintage, commanding look. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern sets tall lowercase against small caps and keeps its curve endings apart, so paragraphs should read smoothly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Woodgod brings vintage command, with generous bowl openings and lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals, to the top of the page. Noto Sans Tagalog then fills the lines beneath with a dominant middle zone.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Woodgod's lowercase rises almost to capital height, and its generously opened bowls give a vintage, commanding feel. But Noto Sans Tai Le's real strength is how softly its strokes taper out.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Woodgod is vintage and commanding, with generous bowls and lowercase that nearly matches its capitals. Noto Sans Tamil already looks magnified, so enlarging it further would make its distant terminals feel oversized.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Woodgod's lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, which gives it a vintage swagger. Down in the text, Noto Sans Telugu keeps a high midline and counters open to the outside, so extended reading stays smooth.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Woodgod carries vintage command in its generously opened bowls and in lowercase that nearly touches capital height. Noto Sans Thai Looped adds bold-looking tall bodies and spacious terminals.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-vai: Lowercase that climbs nearly to capital height and bowls opened generously give Woodgod its vintage, commanding display voice. Woodgod shouts, while Noto Sans Vai builds solid blocks of text.
